title: Engineers describe XF-131 Super Sentinel to Bill McDonald

tellings.quote: In 1992, McDonald met with two Northrup and two Loheed engineers who were fed up with the secrecy and classification of their work who kind of dictated the a drawing of a triangular ARV called the XF-131 Super Sentinel

plain: In 1992, a man named Bill McDonald met four engineers in California's Mojave Desert, two from Northrop and two from Lockheed, both big aircraft makers. Tired of the secrecy around their work, they described to him a triangular craft called the XF-131 Super Sentinel, which he drew from their words. The craft was what is called an ARV, short for alien reproduction vehicle, meaning a human-built craft said to copy alien technology. The story is told by a researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb, passing on McDonald's account, and it would mean such craft were really being built.
